reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness tool that probes runtime, software, hardware, workspace, network, service, port, and printer information for agent use.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 智能体的只读环境探测插件，用于获取运行环境、软件版本、系统资源、硬件、网络、服务和工作区信息。
summaries.en: A read-only DeepSeek Harness environment probe plugin that provides agents with runtime, software, resource, hardware, network, service, and workspace information.

capabilities: Checks command availability and software versions using bounded subprocess probes
Reads workspace project markers and version files
Lists system resources, applications, hardware, network interfaces, ports, services, and printers
